import pathlib,json,hashlib,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as E
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]; repo=root/'planning/utkala-odisha/checkouts/utkal-fieldwork-pack';out=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p=repo/'kb/research/references/census-2011/c16-odisha.xlsx';z=zipfile.ZipFile(p);n={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
ss=[''.join(t.itertext()) for t in E.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')).findall('m:si',n)]
a=json.loads((repo/'kb/research/voices/population-2011.json').read_text());d=a['areas']['390'];rows=[]
for r in E.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')).findall('m:sheetData/m:row',n):
 cells={''.join(filter(str.isalpha,c.attrib['r'])):ss[int(c.find('m:v',n).text)] if c.attrib.get('t')=='s' else c.findtext('m:v','',n) for c in r}
 if cells.get('C')!='390' or cells.get('D')!='00000':continue
 code=cells['F'];v=[int(cells[x]) for x in 'HIJKLMNOP'];assert d['rows'][code]['values']==v;assert d['rows'][code]['source_row']==int(r.attrib['r']);assert a['labels'][code]['source_label'].strip()==cells['G'].strip()
 assert all(v[k]==v[k+1]+v[k+2] for k in [0,3,6]);assert all(v[k]==v[k+3]+v[k+6] for k in range(3))
 rows.append({'row':int(r.attrib['r']),'code':code,'label':cells['G'],'values':v})
groups=[r for r in rows if a['labels'][r['code']]['level']=='language_group'];assert [sum(r['values'][k] for r in groups) for k in range(9)]==d['population']
b=json.loads((out.parent/'baseline.json').read_text());bad=[p for p,s in b['files'].items() if h(repo/p)!=s];assert not bad
result={'source_sha256':h(p),'district':'390','rows':len(rows),'numeric_cells':len(rows)*9,'row_range':[rows[0]['row'],rows[-1]['row']],'groups':len(groups),'subordinates':len(rows)-len(groups),'population':d['population'],'parity':'all numeric cells, labels, codes and source row anchors exact','arithmetic':'all rows and nine parent sums pass','preservation_files':len(b['files']),'preservation_mismatches':bad,'original_rows':rows}
(out/'source-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='original_rows'})
